name: 041.5 — The mouse entity, the grab, and the end of hafen.hook()
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 041.5: hafen.ui():mouse() becomes the pointer entity (:x() :y() :over() :shift() :ctrl() :alt() :grab()), hafen.ui():mouse():grab() hands back an emitter (:on("Move"/"Up", fn), :release()) over the same Subs mechanism as everything else, and hafen.hook() is deleted outright. Run ':t041-5' and follow the one [manual] line: hold a grab and drag across the map.
